questiontext.text: Which of the following elements are essential components of biblical repentance? (Select all that apply)

generalfeedback.text: Biblical repentance involves acknowledging sin, experiencing godly contrition, and turning toward righteousness. Blame-shifting is the opposite of repentance.

name.text: W01_Q18: Christian Religious Studies JSS1 Assessment

questiontext.text: Which of the following statements correctly describe Zacchaeus' response to meeting Jesus in Jericho? (Select all that apply)

generalfeedback.text: Zacchaeus welcomed Jesus joyfully, gave half his wealth to the poor, and pledged fourfold restitution to anyone he had defrauded (Luke 19:6, 8).

name.text: W01_Q19: Christian Religious Studies JSS1 Assessment

questiontext.text: Match each biblical person with their role in the accounts of King David and Zacchaeus:

generalfeedback.text: Nathan delivered the parable; David repented in Psalm 51; Zacchaeus made fourfold restitution; and Uriah was the loyal soldier wronged by David.

name.text: W01_Q20: Christian Religious Studies JSS1 Assessment

questiontext.text: Match each key theological term with its proper definition:

generalfeedback.text: Metanoia is turning of mind/heart; restitution is repaying defrauded goods; contrition is godly sorrow; and absolution is divine forgiveness.
